```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(microbiomeMarker)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
})

############################################################
# 1. Paths
############################################################

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"

data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
results_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Results")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")

metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

viral_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

lefse_results_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "LEfSe")
lefse_figures_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "LEfSe")

dir.create(lefse_results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(lefse_figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

############################################################
# 2. Read metadata
############################################################

meta <- read.delim(
  metadata_file_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"

required_meta_cols <- c("sample_label", "reads_ID", "outcome", "sPTB34", "bmi")

missing_meta_cols <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, colnames(meta))

if (length(missing_meta_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing metadata columns: ", paste(missing_meta_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)

############################################################
# 3. Functions
############################################################

read_and_align_matrix <- function(matrix_file, meta) {
  
  mat <- read.delim(
    matrix_file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))
  
  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)
  
  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    stop("Unmatched samples found: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  meta_aligned <- meta[
    match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
  ]
  
  if (!all(meta_aligned$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)) {
    stop("Metadata order mismatch")
  }
  
  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  rownames(meta_aligned) <- meta_aligned$reads_ID
  
  mat <- as.data.frame(mat)
  mat[] <- lapply(mat, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  
  list(
    mat = mat,
    meta = meta_aligned
  )
}

make_relative_abundance <- function(mat) {
  
  row_totals <- rowSums(mat)
  keep_samples <- row_totals > 0
  
  mat <- mat[keep_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  row_totals <- row_totals[keep_samples]
  
  mat_rel <- sweep(mat, 1, row_totals, "/")
  mat_rel <- mat_rel[, colSums(mat_rel) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  
  return(mat_rel)
}

make_phyloseq_for_lefse <- function(mat_rel, meta_model) {
  
  otu <- otu_table(
    as.matrix(t(mat_rel)),
    taxa_are_rows = TRUE
  )
  
  tax <- tax_table(
    as.matrix(
      data.frame(
        Genus = colnames(mat_rel),
        row.names = colnames(mat_rel),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  )
  
  samp <- sample_data(meta_model)
  
  phyloseq(otu, tax, samp)
}

extract_lefse_table <- function(lefse_result) {
  
  marker_df <- as.data.frame(marker_table(lefse_result))
  
  if (nrow(marker_df) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  marker_df <- marker_df %>%
    rownames_to_column("marker_id")
  
  return(marker_df)
}

plot_lefse_lda <- function(marker_df, dataset_name, comparison_name) {
  
  if (nrow(marker_df) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  lda_col <- intersect(c("lda", "ef_lda", "lda_score"), colnames(marker_df))[1]
  group_col <- intersect(c("enrich_group", "group", "class"), colnames(marker_df))[1]
  feature_col <- intersect(c("feature", "taxon", "marker", "marker_id"), colnames(marker_df))[1]
  
  if (is.na(lda_col) || is.na(group_col) || is.na(feature_col)) {
    warning("Could not identify LEfSe plotting columns.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  plot_df <- marker_df %>%
    mutate(
      lda_score = as.numeric(.data[[lda_col]]),
      group = as.factor(.data[[group_col]]),
      feature = as.character(.data[[feature_col]])
    ) %>%
    arrange(lda_score) %>%
    mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = unique(feature)))
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = lda_score, y = feature, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("LEfSe discriminant taxa: ", dataset_name),
      subtitle = comparison_name,
      x = "LDA score",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Enriched group"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

run_lefse_analysis <- function(
    matrix_file,
    dataset_name,
    comparison_name,
    group_column,
    group_levels,
    lda_cutoff = 1.0
) {
  
  message("Running LEfSe: ", dataset_name, " | ", comparison_name)
  
  aligned <- read_and_align_matrix(matrix_file, meta)
  
  mat <- aligned$mat
  meta_aligned <- aligned$meta
  
  keep <- !is.na(meta_aligned[[group_column]]) &
    meta_aligned[[group_column]] %in% group_levels
  
  mat <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_model <- meta_aligned[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  
  meta_model$lefse_group <- factor(
    meta_model[[group_column]],
    levels = group_levels
  )
  
  mat_rel <- make_relative_abundance(mat)
  meta_model <- meta_model[rownames(mat_rel), , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (!all(rownames(mat_rel) == meta_model$reads_ID)) {
    stop("Post-filtering metadata order mismatch")
  }
  
  group_counts <- table(meta_model$lefse_group)
  
  if (sum(group_counts > 0) < 2) {
    stop("LEfSe requires at least two non-empty groups.")
  }
  
  ps <- make_phyloseq_for_lefse(mat_rel, meta_model)
  
  lefse_result <- run_lefse(
    ps,
    group = "lefse_group",
    norm = "none",
    kw_cutoff = 0.05,
    wilcoxon_cutoff = 0.05,
    lda_cutoff = lda_cutoff,
    multigrp_strat = FALSE
  )
  
  marker_df <- extract_lefse_table(lefse_result)
  
  saveRDS(
    lefse_result,
    file.path(
      lefse_results_dir,
      paste0("LEfSe_", dataset_name, "_", comparison_name, ".rds")
    )
  )
  
  write_csv(
    marker_df,
    file.path(
      lefse_results_dir,
      paste0("LEfSe_markers_", dataset_name, "_", comparison_name, ".csv")
    )
  )
  
  lda_plot <- plot_lefse_lda(marker_df, dataset_name, comparison_name)
  
  if (!is.null(lda_plot)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        lefse_figures_dir,
        paste0("LEfSe_LDA_", dataset_name, "_", comparison_name, ".png")
      ),
      plot = lda_plot,
      width = 8,
      height = max(4, 0.3 * nrow(marker_df) + 2),
      dpi = 300
    )
  }
  
  sample_count_df <- as.data.frame(group_counts) %>%
    rename(group = Var1, n = Freq)
  
  write_csv(
    sample_count_df,
    file.path(
      lefse_results_dir,
      paste0("LEfSe_sample_counts_", dataset_name, "_", comparison_name, ".csv")
    )
  )
  
  list(
    lefse_result = lefse_result,
    markers = marker_df,
    sample_counts = sample_count_df,
    lda_cutoff = lda_cutoff
  )
}

############################################################
# 4. Run LEfSe analyses
############################################################

fungi_sPTB34_lefse <- run_lefse_analysis(
  matrix_file = fungal_file,
  dataset_name = "RefSeq_fungi",
  comparison_name = "sPTB34_yes_vs_no",
  group_column = "sPTB34",
  group_levels = c("no", "yes"),
  lda_cutoff = 1.0
)

viruses_sPTB34_lefse <- run_lefse_analysis(
  matrix_file = viral_file,
  dataset_name = "RefSeq_viruses",
  comparison_name = "sPTB34_yes_vs_no",
  group_column = "sPTB34",
  group_levels = c("no", "yes"),
  lda_cutoff = 1.0
)

fungi_outcome_lefse <- run_lefse_analysis(
  matrix_file = fungal_file,
  dataset_name = "RefSeq_fungi",
  comparison_name = "TERM_vs_sPTB",
  group_column = "outcome",
  group_levels = c("TERM", "sPTB"),
  lda_cutoff = 1.0
)

viruses_outcome_lefse <- run_lefse_analysis(
  matrix_file = viral_file,
  dataset_name = "RefSeq_viruses",
  comparison_name = "TERM_vs_sPTB",
  group_column = "outcome",
  group_levels = c("TERM", "sPTB"),
  lda_cutoff = 1.0
)

############################################################
# 5. Combined marker table
############################################################

combined_lefse_markers <- bind_rows(
  fungi_sPTB34_lefse$markers %>%
    mutate(dataset = "RefSeq fungi", comparison = "sPTB34 yes vs no"),
  viruses_sPTB34_lefse$markers %>%
    mutate(dataset = "RefSeq viruses", comparison = "sPTB34 yes vs no"),
  fungi_outcome_lefse$markers %>%
    mutate(dataset = "RefSeq fungi", comparison = "TERM vs sPTB"),
  viruses_outcome_lefse$markers %>%
    mutate(dataset = "RefSeq viruses", comparison = "TERM vs sPTB")
)

write_csv(
  combined_lefse_markers,
  file.path(lefse_results_dir, "LEfSe_combined_marker_table.csv")
)

############################################################
# 6. Summary table documenting null LEfSe result
############################################################

lefse_summary <- data.frame(
  dataset = c(
    "RefSeq fungi",
    "RefSeq viruses",
    "RefSeq fungi",
    "RefSeq viruses"
  ),
  comparison = c(
    "sPTB34 yes vs no",
    "sPTB34 yes vs no",
    "TERM vs sPTB",
    "TERM vs sPTB"
  ),
  group_1 = c("no", "no", "TERM", "TERM"),
  group_2 = c("yes", "yes", "sPTB", "sPTB"),
  group_1_n = c(
    fungi_sPTB34_lefse$sample_counts$n[1],
    viruses_sPTB34_lefse$sample_counts$n[1],
    fungi_outcome_lefse$sample_counts$n[1],
    viruses_outcome_lefse$sample_counts$n[1]
  ),
  group_2_n = c(
    fungi_sPTB34_lefse$sample_counts$n[2],
    viruses_sPTB34_lefse$sample_counts$n[2],
    fungi_outcome_lefse$sample_counts$n[2],
    viruses_outcome_lefse$sample_counts$n[2]
  ),
  lda_cutoff = c(
    fungi_sPTB34_lefse$lda_cutoff,
    viruses_sPTB34_lefse$lda_cutoff,
    fungi_outcome_lefse$lda_cutoff,
    viruses_outcome_lefse$lda_cutoff
  ),
  significant_markers = c(
    nrow(fungi_sPTB34_lefse$markers),
    nrow(viruses_sPTB34_lefse$markers),
    nrow(fungi_outcome_lefse$markers),
    nrow(viruses_outcome_lefse$markers)
  )
)

lefse_summary$interpretation <- ifelse(
  lefse_summary$significant_markers == 0,
  "No discriminant taxa identified",
  "Discriminant taxa detected"
)

write_csv(
  lefse_summary,
  file.path(lefse_results_dir, "LEfSe_summary_table.csv")
)


############################################################
# 7. Save session information
############################################################

sink(file.path(lefse_results_dir, "LEfSe_sessionInfo.txt"))
sessionInfo()
sink()

message("LEfSe analysis complete.")
```
